title: zLink
description: This plugin adds a configurable way to create your own minecraft bridge linking system. It connects via mongo database (more on the way) and gives user a code to link on your application/project.
body:
zLink is your custom link plugin. It works by connecting to a database and giving the user a code, that code the user can input into your project to link their account. Right now you can fetch the users uuid, luckperms rank, display name, world, game mode and when they first joined. 

**Please Note: This plugin is still in beta, there will be bugs and it will not be perfect.**

If you would like to get releases before it comes here please visit: [Our Official Website](https://link.zavrobot.tech/)
